# DELETE /api/v1/user/gpg_keys/{id}

Remove a GPG key belonging to the authenticated user

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-189`

| id | path | int64 | True |

- **403** — Permission denied
